verdict.rationale: Apify's docs explicitly document webhooks that fire on Actor run events (finish/fail) and can trigger downstream actions like starting another Actor, confirming a native pub/sub-style webhook subscription mechanism. This is first-party documented core platform functionality, though the evidence lacks detail on webhook payload customization or independent hands-on validation. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of webhook reliability, and documentation of full event-type coverage beyond run finish/fail.
